s: Drew and Jimmy's wife Nancy own the production company Flower Films. In grade school he was voted most likely to replace David Letterman. In June of 2003, he guest-hosted for Dave. Often did dead-on impersonations of John Lennon and Mick Jagger on Saturday Night Live (1975).
